jobs.title: Housing and Homeless Services Program Manager*
jobs.description:
**The Job**
-----------

  

  

The **Office** **of Homeless Services (OHS)** is seeking an experienced **Housing and Homeless Services** **Program Manager\*** who isresponsible for overseeing daily operations and performance across multiple shelter and housing programs. The role ensures alignment with County priorities, monitors program utilization, Homeless Management Information System (HMIS) compliance, and conducts onsite evaluations to maintain safety, quality, and contractual adherence. The position facilitates interdepartmental collaboration, manages relationships with contracted providers, and serves as a primary liaison during community and interagency meetings. Additional responsibilities include supporting contract compliance, ensuring accurate data and required reporting, analyzing program trends, and assists with resolving complex issues.  

  

  

***Key Responsibilities include but are not limited to:*** **Program Oversight and Operations**

* Provide daily operational oversight for multiple County housing projects and initiatives.
* Ensure all programs operate in alignment with County strategic priorities.
* Monitor program performance metrics, bed/unit utilization, and HMIS compliance, consistent with coordination described during the HMIS Bed and Unit Inventory Demo.
* Conduct onsite support visits to evaluate program quality, safety, and adherence to contractual requirements.

**Care Coordination Leadership**

* Lead cross\-department care coordination efforts with the Department of Behavioral Health (DBH) (AJI, PACE, LTC), Transitional Assistance Department (TAD), Community Development and Housing (CDH) Department, Office of Emergency Services (OES), the County's Chief Executive Officer (CEO), County Counsel, and provider partners.
* Oversee referral pathways, client transitions between programs, and ensure timely delivery of services to support client stabilization and successful exits to permanent housing.
* Ensure care coordination workflows are organized, documented, and updated.

**Interdepartmental and Provider Collaboration**

* Facilitate regular coordination meetings with county departments—including TAD, DBH, CDH, and OES.
* Build strong relationships with contracted providers operating shelters, residential programs, and supportive housing sites to ensure adherence to standards, reporting requirements, and performance objectives.
* Serve as primary liaison between OHS leadership and external organizations during community meetings and interagency collaborations.

**Contract and Compliance Management**

* Support oversight of contract performance and compliance with County policies, state regulations, and funding requirements.
* Collaborate with DBH, County Counsel, the CEO, and procurement teams.
* Ensure programs maintain required documentation, outcome tracking, incident reporting, and adherence to Housing First principles.

**Data, Reporting and System Coordination**

* Oversee HMIS data accuracy, monthly reporting, bed\-inventory updates, and utilization tracking—mirroring coordination reflected during HMIS Bed and Unit Inventory Demo.
* Review provider reports, analyze program trends, and elevate issues needing departmental or executive attention.
* Ensure timely submission of required reports for state/federal grants, internal dashboards, and program monitoring.

**Leadership and Team Support**

* Provide guidance and support to OHS staff working across multiple programs.
* Coordinate internal OHS strategic planning sessions and cross\-team alignment meetings.
* Offer coaching, problem\-solving assistance, and help staff navigate complex client cases or provider issues.

* *Official Job Title:* Program Manager


For more detailed information, refer to the Program Manager job description.  

**JOIN OUR TEAM \& MAKE AN IMPACT IN YOUR COMMUNITY!** **EXCELLENT BENEFITS**
To review job\- specific benefits, refer to:**Benefits by Occupational Unit (BbOU) Summary \- Management Unit**  

**Employee Benefits**  

**Memorandum of Understanding (MOU)** **CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT****Pre\-employment Process:** Applicants must pass a background check, which includes credit check, DOJ Live Scan fingerprinting, DMV check, and physical exam including drug testing, prior to appointment. **Travel*****:***Travel throughout the County is required. A valid California Class C Driver License is required to carry out the essential job\-related functions of this position. Mileage reimbursement may be available at current IRS rates. A clean driving record and proof of automobile liability insurance must be maintained. **Sponsorship:** San Bernardino County is not able to consider candidates who will require visa sponsorship at the time of application or in the future. Candidates will be required to present their legal right to work in the United States prior to employment.
**Minimum Requirements**
------------------------


Applicants must meet the following education and experience requirements:  

**Education:**  


A bachelor's degree in Public/Business Administration, Social Science, Psychology, Humanities, or a closely related field of study.  

**\-AND\-**  

  

**Experience:**
Three (3\) years of full\-time equivalent, progressively responsible professional administrative experience in a combination of the following areas: policy development and evaluation; strategic program planning, development, implementation, and evaluation; contract and grant development, administration, and monitoring; budget oversight; high\-level research and data analytics; and interpersonal, public, and community relations. Experience must be obtained in a housing, homeless services, behavioral health, or social services program within a government agency, professional community organization, or closely related setting.  

  

Experience must include at least one (1\) year as a full\-scope supervisor or manager over technical or professional staff. Experience may be concurrent.

jobs.title: Dental Front office Patient Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the Position:**

We are seeking a full time(4 days/ week) Front office Admin for our General Dentistry office in Cupertino, CA. We are looking for a person who has both excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills. 1 year of Dental office front desk experience is a requirement. Our practice is committed to excellence in both dentistry and patient care, and this person is tasked with ensuring these standards are met on a daily basis.

The Admin is responsible for the following essential duties:

* Helping to create an atmosphere that ensures the highest quality dental experience for patients
* Maintaining a friendly and welcoming relationship with all patients
* Responsible for answering phones and greeting patients with professionalism and care
* Presenting treatment plans, collecting payments
* Verifying insurance eligibility and estimating co\-pays
* Scheduling patients and collecting all necessary information
* Being part of the high standards for ethical and professional conduct at all times
* Participating in the goals of the practice
* Accurate balancing of all office transactions
* Thoroughly answering patients’ questions
* Reviewing aging report and following up with patients to collect the balance

The ideal candidate will have at least the minimum skills and abilities:

* A high attention to detail and ability to problem solve
* Able to multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong background in Dentrix and understanding of dental insurances
* Superior communication skills, both written and verbal
* Highly organized and energetic
* Must have experience and in\-depth knowledge of dental systems
* High level of professionalism\- including attire and appearance

This is a great opportunity for a skilled professional with a dental background.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $20\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* What is your expected starting pay per hour?
* What date are you available to start working?
* Do you have experience with Dentrix Software?
* Can you verify dental PPO insurance for patients?

Experience:

* Dental Front Office: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Program Manager I - OPG/Age Wise*
jobs.description:
**The Job**
-----------

  

  

The **Department of Aging and Adult Services \- Public Guardian** is recruiting for **Program Manager I\*** for the **Age Wise Program**. The **Age Wise Program** is a seven\-time national award\-winning behavioral health and wellness program that serves the older adult community throughout San Bernardino County. The **Program Manager** oversees a key program area and supports the planning and coordination of a comprehensive behavioral health program; preparing, monitoring and enforcing contracts with behavioral health service providers; and providing clinical and/or administrative supervision. ***A vacancy currently exists in the Department of Aging and Adult Services \- Public Guardian's Age Wise Program.*** *The resulting eligible list will only be used to fill vacancies within the Department of Aging and Adult Services \- Public Guardian.*

 **EXCELLENT BENEFITS**
To review job\-specific, benefits, refer to:**Summary of Benefits****Memorandum of Understanding (MOU)*** ***Official title:*** *Mental Health Program Manager I*.

  

For more detailed information, refer to the Mental Health Program Manager I job description.**CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT**

**Background Investigation:** Applicants must pass a background investigation, which includes fingerprinting, credit check, and/or medical exam, prior to appointment.

**Travel:** Travelthroughout the County may be required. Employees may be required to make provision for transportation and to use personal vehicles (mileage reimbursement is available). At the time of hire, a valid California Class C driver license and proof of automobile liability insurance must be produced and maintained for the individual providing the transportation.

**License:** Position requires licensure as a Licensed Marriage Family Therapist (LMFT), Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), or Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor (LPCC). Applicants must provide license information on the supplemental questionnaire to be considered.

**Training:** Incumbents must complete forty (40\) units of CA State Association of Public Administrators, Public Guardian, and Public Conservators training within a four (4\) year period.

**Sponsorship****:** Please note San Bernardino County is not able to consider candidates who will require visa sponsorship at the time of application or in the future. **Work Location:** Incumbents will be assigned to work at the Office of the Public Guardian (OPG) located at 686 E. Mill St. San Bernardino, CA 92415\-0647\. Office location may change due to space and department operational needs.  


**Minimum Requirements**
------------------------


**License:** Position requires licensure as a Licensed Marriage Family Therapist (LMFT), Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), or Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor (LPCC). *Applicants must provide license information on the supplemental questionnaire to be considered.*  

  

**\-AND\-**  

  

**Education**: Bachelor's degree or equivalent in behavioral or social science, healthcare administration, human services, public/business administration, legal studies, or related field of study.  

  

**\-AND\-**  

  

**Experience**: Two (2\) years of full\-time professional\-level administrative, clinical, and/or supervisory experience, **which includes** one (1\) year working within a mental health system with responsibilities in one or more of the following areas: development and monitoring of programs, policies and procedures; compliance/quality management; data/legislative analysis; monitoring contracts; or budget/fiscal administration. *Clerical* *and/or routine accounting experience is not considered qualifying.*  

  

*A Master's degree in a qualifying field may substitute for up to one (1\) year of the required experience, with one (1\) year of experience working within a mental health system.*


**Desired Qualifications**
--------------------------


The ideal candidate will possess a Master’s degree in a qualifying field and at least one (1\) year of experience supervising a behavioral health or other governmental program.
